description: Trajets des trains de la SNCB is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by NMBS-SNCB. Lignes ferroviaires exploitées par la SNCB en Belgique. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are transport, commun, trajet, train, sncb, statique. The portal shows 605 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2021-01-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other-open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
